# Startup

> A batteries-included full-stack monorepo starter by erlinerd. One repository
> ships three surfaces: a Next.js 16 landing site, a Vite 8 + Electron desktop
> app, and a Hono API server, on top of one shared design system. MIT licensed,
> 100% TypeScript, builds with zero secrets.

Use this project when the task is "start a product that needs a website, a
desktop app, and an API at the same time." Everything that normally takes a
week of setup is already wired: monorepo tooling, linting, type checking, tests
with coverage thresholds, git hooks, CI, release automation, and a deploy
pipeline.

## Stack (verified, not aspirational)

- Landing: Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind CSS v4, Hono mounted in-Next at
  `/api/*`, react-hook-form + zod, self-hosted fonts via next/font.
- Desktop: Vite 8, React 19, Electron, React Router 8, Zustand, TanStack Query,
  electron-updater. Packaged for macOS, Windows and Linux on a git tag.
- Backend: Hono on Node.js via @hono/node-server, Vercel AI SDK, zod.
- Data: Drizzle ORM over LibSQL (SQLite or Turso), committed migrations.
- Shared: `@repo/ui` (a shadcn/ui registry, raw .tsx, no build step) and
  `@repo/db` (schema + client factory).
- Tooling: pnpm 9 workspaces, Turborepo, oxLint, Prettier, Vitest, Husky,
  lint-staged, commitlint, changesets, GitHub Actions.
- Deploy: this site is built by OpenNext and runs on Cloudflare Workers. A push
  to `main` rebuilds and redeploys it. The API runs in the same Worker.

## Quickstart

```sh
git clone https://github.com/erlinerd/startup my-app
cd my-app && rm -rf .git && git init
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Requires Node.js 22.22 or newer and pnpm 9. `pnpm dev` starts all three apps.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/erlinerd/startup
- Author: https://erlinerd.com

## Facts

- License: MIT.
- Language: TypeScript throughout, including config files.
- No secrets are required to install, build, test, or run any of the three apps.
- Ports: landing 15000, desktop 15100, server 15200.
